_comment: Cloudflare Workers config. workerd is not Node: no @types/node here, and types is [] - a Worker's ambient runtime types come from its own generated worker-configuration.d.ts (`wrangler types --env dev --strict-vars=false`), which the package commits to git and lists in its tsconfig include. @cloudflare/workers-types is deliberately NOT used: Cloudflare superseded it with `wrangler types`, and the generated file is binding-exact (it types a DO namespace as DurableObjectNamespace<TheClass> and knows which vars exist). Wrangler/esbuild does the bundling, so tsc is type-check-only (noEmit). Test-only pool types (`@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers/types`) belong in the package's tsconfig.test.json, not here.
